decisions.reason: As a low-cost exploratory option that still has homepage visibility, the accelerator is worth keeping open for learning and partnership access despite its indirect fit with the firm's core machinery business.

The binder has survived for two years on its own product page, so management would likely continue it as a still-uncertain but plausible growth option, though its non-core market and commercialization demands raise the chance of exit if traction stays limited.

This plant is prominently featured on the homepage across both years and fits the firm's equipment capabilities, so under real-options logic it remains a strong option to retain while market adoption continues to clarify.
